intervals.label: Ring Cyclotron went into operation
intervals.note: Sourced to Wikipedia only; the official psi.ch pages tried (checked 2026-09-17) returned HTTP 404. The machine has been upgraded substantially since 1974 (for example to a beam power of 1.4 MW, see the beam-power spec), but no source consulted gives a separate upgrade-interval date.
intervals.quote: Like the Injector-2, the Ring Cyclotron, which has a circumference of about 48 m, went into operation in 1974.

name: High Intensity Proton Accelerator
notes: Beam power: the official psi.ch/en/cas/hipa page (checked 2026-09-17) gives 1.4 MW. The 1.3 MW figure in the Wikipedia article is the current beam allocation to SINQ/SmuS, not the facility's own headline power. The 1974 start year is corroborated by an official PSI news story (src:facilities-verify-psi-hipa-turns-50: 'went into operation in 1974') in addition to Wikipedia.

beam_energy.note: Upgraded 2026-09-17 from Wikipedia-only to PSI's own official HIPA page.
beam_energy.quote: accelerates the proton bunches up to 590 MeV (79 % of the speed of light)

beam_power.note: PSI's own official HIPA page states the facility's beam power as 1.4 MW; the 1.3 MW figure in the Wikipedia article ('The 1.3 MW strong proton beam is directed towards...') describes the current beam distribution.
beam_power.quote: The High Intensity Proton Accelerator Facility (HIPA) provides a 1.4 MW proton beam for the production of mesons and neutrons.
